== Lead photograph (30 Oct 2026) ==
The lead is a crop of a Facebook photograph posted 29 July 2021. The uncropped original is in Photographs. The Facebook photo viewer names Ronald Fonck. Identification: distinctive name plus Bravo 24 on the Decipher Squadron roster (Joliet, Il); the Facebook profile is facebook.com/ronald.fonck and the group member card listed Joliet West High School.

Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook photo-viewer screenshot (Wayback 20261030145412 of the Route C snapshot). Identification stays on this Talk page. See [[:File:Ronald Fonck Facebook portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Ronald Fonck portrait.jpg]].
